notes: ZND-2 landfall direction + one-fire lock (CR 603.8b). Canopy Baloth's compiled Landfall trigger is the ONLY +2/+2 source in the pack, so the EOT grant doubles as the trigger-fire counter. (1) Own land drop (op 'play', the real CR 305.1 lane): exactly ONE fire -> 4/3 becomes 6/5; an 8 would be the double-fire bug (e.g. an event that matches both the drop and a re-settle). (2) Opponent's land enters (seat 1): the event's to_zone controller YOU and the subject CONTROLLER_IS YOU filter each independently reject the seat-1 entry -> baloth stays 6; a bump to 8 is the direction bug (spec /101 FM2 direction falsifier). (3) A NON-LAND creature (vanilla Cliffhaven Sell-Sword, no rules text, no triggers of its own) enters under seat 0: the subject filter TYPE_EQ 'Land' rejects it -> still 6/5; the Sell-Sword's own 3/1 proves nothing else granted PT. No end_turn: the grant is deliberately still inside its 'until end of turn' window at assertion time.
